upstream.description: Everything you need to know to build your own RAG application

classification.analysis: bRAG-langchain is a set of Jupyter notebooks that teach Retrieval-Augmented Generation from the ground up, using LangChain, LangSmith tracing, and vector stores like ChromaDB/Pinecone. It progresses from a basic RAG pipeline through multi-query retrieval, semantic/logical routing, multi-representation indexing (RAPTOR, ColBERT), and reranking (RRF, Cohere), with a single full_basic_rag.ipynb offered as a customizable boilerplate chatbot starter. Aimed at developers learning to build or extend their own RAG applications rather than at production deployment.

use_cases.title: Bootstrap a RAG chatbot from a notebook starter
Learn multi-query and routing techniques for retrieval pipelines
Compare reranking strategies like RRF and Cohere rerank
Prototype advanced indexing with RAPTOR or ColBERT
